name: flashdrop
description: Live-shopping flash-sale platform: Redis admits, Postgres decides, Kafka carries the news, timers clean up.

scripts.infra:up: tsx tools/ensure-env.ts && docker compose up --detach --wait postgres redis redis-test kafka && docker compose run --rm kafka-init
scripts.stack:up: tsx tools/ensure-env.ts && docker buildx bake --file docker-bake.hcl --load && docker compose --profile app up --detach --wait --wait-timeout 300 && docker compose exec -T caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --profile app rm --stop --force migrate api-1 api-2 web worker listing consumers dashboard-consumers payment-mock caddy
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose --profile app logs --follow --tail=100 migrate api-1 api-2 web worker listing consumers dashboard-consumers payment-mock caddy
scripts.db:reset-dev: tsx packages/db/src/cli/reset-dev.ts && tsx tools/reset-redis-dev.ts && tsx tools/seed.ts
scripts.dlq:replay: docker compose --profile app run --rm --no-deps consumers node apps/worker/dist/dlq-replay.js
scripts.load:burst: docker compose --profile load run --rm k6 run /scripts/burst.ts
scripts.load:idempotency: docker compose --profile load run --rm k6 run /scripts/idempotency-storm.ts
scripts.load:expiry-soak: docker compose --profile load run --rm k6 run /scripts/expiry-soak.ts
scripts.load:ws-fanout: docker compose --profile load run --rm k6 run /scripts/ws-fanout.ts
scripts.demo:burst: docker compose --profile load run --rm k6 run /scripts/burst.ts -e PROFILE=demo -e OPEN_DELAY_S=20 && pnpm verify:invariants
